summary:
THE WEEK SHE STARTED ASKING AGAIN — AND THE WEEK OUR BILLING INSTRUCTIONS FELL APART. Last week's report said the defining risk on this account was that she had stopped asking us for anything. That reversed, hard. In seven days Sarah made four real asks — she raised her main Instagram herself for the first time in 35 days ('Hey @fonta could we please add a fake last name to my instagram and then verify the account?😁', Sep 13), she asked for urgent help at 00:40 before a video call, she asked to be able to track her referrals, and she flagged a chargeback. She also did every single thing we asked of her, immediately: 'Have just uploaded 2x photo folders. Will upload at least 1 new folder every day. Let’s get it!!' (Sep 12). Her volume went from 6 messages in the previous week to 26. TWO THINGS WENT GENUINELY RIGHT. Stephski restored the pre-invoice heads-up on Sep 14 and sent the Sep 1-14 invoice ON Sep 15 — a second consecutive clean cycle, and the Aug 21 report's top failure is now demonstrably fixed. And when Sarah asked 'Also, is there any chance of me being able to track my referrals?' at 19:22 on Sep 16, Stephski had a live tracking sheet in her hands four hours later ('Here ya go 🙂 I update this biweekly as invoices go out'). Referral deductions caused three late invoices in a row (Jul 1-14 re-issue, Jul 15-31 slipped to Aug 3, Aug 1-14 slipped to Aug 21); she has now been handed the ledger. That is the best single piece of client service on this account in two months. EVERYTHING ELSE IS THE SAME REPORT AGAIN, EIGHT DAYS OLDER. Zero carried commitments closed for a THIRD consecutive reporting period. @sarah.h44 is 40 days down and there is still not one written word from ALTR about its status — she volunteered the login again (plaintext, in the group chat) and Vivek's complete written output across the entire window was nine words: 'Yes', 'Send logins', 'Send desire name', 'Yo Ma’am check dm'. The two backup accounts are 43 days down and were not mentioned by anyone. The earnings plan is 41 days old and Ronnie has now been absent from this chat for 35 days. Derrek's Phone Farm updates are 48 days past the promise; he broke 24 days of silence at 05:48 on Sep 18 to post five words about a chargeback — 'damn OF Is on their shit' — which is now the most recent thing the owner has ever said to this client. Olivia surfaced after 15 days only to ask HER for something ('Hi babe what are the tags for the people in your b/g and g/g content?'), with the AI voice fix 20 days open and the Sep 2 OFTV call still unwritten. THREE THINGS ARE NEW AND BAD. (1) BANKING. On Sep 15 Stephski sent two messages 35 seconds apart that contradict each other: 'Please note a slight name change to the account, but the same account and wire info' and then 'It is very important that you send to this Bank of America account instead of the Chase you’ve sent to in the past because we no longer have that account open'. That is the SIXTH change of payment instructions in twelve months, it includes a change to the PAYEE NAME, it was delivered in a 19-participant group chat, and it came two and a half months after 'we have a new bank for you to send to (last change I promise!)'. As of the window close she has not paid, and Stephski has chased twice. (2) THE ONE SERVICE THAT HAD NEVER LAPSED, LAPSED. Michelle Queue's weekly leak-removal breakdown ran without a miss for seven straight weeks (Jul 26, Aug 1, 10, 17, 25, Sep 1, Sep 8) and then did not post at all this window — ten days and counting. The ~20 links Sarah hand-collected on 2026-07-18 are now 62 days old. (3) SECURITY GOT WORSE FOR A FIFTH STRAIGHT WINDOW, AND THIS TIME IT WAS THE MAIN ACCOUNT. On Sep 13-14 she typed a new password ('[REDACTED-PASSWORD]'), a 2FA code ('[REDACTED-2FA-CODE]'), a recovery email and then her MAIN ACCOUNT CREDENTIALS ('My login is
Sarah.h44
[REDACTED-PASSWORD]') into the group chat — and a new participant was added to that chat on Sep 17 at 22:02. Three days later Mica Vecco posted a security broadcast telling her 'Please do not send your backup codes to anyone, including our team.' We are giving her correct security advice in the same topic where we ask her to break it.

health.rationale: Up 2 from 46 on 2026-09-11, and this is a fragile, narrowly-earned 'up' driven by exactly two things: billing and her own re-engagement. Billing is now genuinely fixed on the part that was broken. Stephski posted the pre-invoice heads-up on Sep 14 ('Will reach out to you tomorrow' behaviour restored after being skipped on Sep 1), sent the Sep 1-14 invoice ON Sep 15 as promised, and when asked for referral visibility at 19:22 on Sep 16 delivered a live tracking sheet by 23:29 the same night. That closes the root cause of three consecutive late invoices and an eleven-month transparency gap, in four hours. Last week's prediction (a) — 'if the Sep 15 invoice is on time and correct, the billing process is genuinely fixed' — resolved in ALTR's favour for the second cycle running. Prediction (b) — 'she will not raise @sarah.h44' — was WRONG, and being wrong is the best news on this account: after 35 days of not naming it she raised her main Instagram herself on Sep 13 and handed over the login. Engagement quadrupled, 26 client messages against 6 the week before, exactly as prediction (d) said it would once more than one ALTR person started conversations — six did. What holds this below 50 is that the delivery core has not moved for a third consecutive reporting period and two brand-new risks opened. ZERO carried commitments closed. Every one aged again: @sarah.h44 40 days with still no written status of any kind, the two backup IGs 43 days and unmentioned by anybody, the earnings plan 41 days with its owner 35 days absent, the Phone Farm updates 48 days, the Jul 18 leak links 62 days, the 'mt cook hike' confirmation 35 days, credentials-out-of-the-group-chat 28 days and worse every single week. The new risks are serious. The Sep 15 invoice shipped with two contradictory banking instructions 35 seconds apart, a change to the payee name, and an assertion that the Chase account is closed — the sixth change of payment instructions in twelve months, on the heels of 'last change I promise!' in July. She has not paid three days on, against an 18-hour turnaround last cycle, and has been chased twice. And Michelle Queue's weekly leak breakdown, the only ALTR service on this account that had never once failed in seven weeks, simply did not run. Two smaller failures matter more than they look. At 00:41 on Sep 13 she wrote 'Or anyone that can help me lol, I have a video call in an hour and a half and I’m stressed bc I have no idea what to do😂😭' into a chat with nineteen participants, and the first reply came four and a half hours later, long after the call: 'I’m awake now Sarah !!'. And Mayson opened a FOURTH new workstream on Sep 16 — 'Hey Sarah do you have a facebook account available to use?' — a question Mica asked her in September 2025 and again in January 2026, and which she had actually acted on two weeks ago. She answered, he said 'If you have it linked it’s better to not use it like that', and it was dropped. Four workstreams launched in three weeks, zero carried items closed. The account is still a cooperative, fully engaged client being held together by one biller and one chatter while everything she actually pays us for sits untouched.
